about.description: Felix is a HIP-3 builder-deployed perpetual venue on Hyperliquid that launched its first market (TSLA) on November 13, 2025 powered by HyperStone (RedStone) oracles. It offers public-equity, equity-index, and commodity perpetual markets, all margined and cash-settled in USDH (or feUSD where supported), giving users synthetic price exposure rather than ownership of the underlying assets. Felix also operates a separate borrowing protocol on HyperEVM (Liquity v2 fork minting feUSD) with its founder coming from DeFi risk-management firm Anthias.xyz; both products are unified under the Felix Protocol brand. Markets appear under the flx namespace on Hyperliquid.
about.registryInfo: Felix Protocol's founder previously worked at Anthias.xyz, a DeFi risk-management firm. The team holds an exclusive license from Liquity AG to repurpose and deploy Liquity v2 on HyperEVM (the borrowing/feUSD product). Felix's perpetual product is deployed under the flx namespace on Hyperliquid via HIP-3, with HyperStone (RedStone) providing oracle feeds for its first HIP-3 market (TSLA, launched November 13, 2025).

fees.revenueNotes: Felix is a HIP-3 builder-deployer on Hyperliquid focused on lending and perpetual markets. Trading fees follow HIP-3 framework: standard taker ~7-9 bps, Growth Mode taker ~0.45-0.9 bps. 50% of fees go to Felix deployer, 50% to Hyperliquid protocol. Felix also earns lending spread from its money-market vault. Source: https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/hyperliquid-improvement-proposals-hips/hip-3-builder-deployed-perpetuals
